user.title: Islamic Prayer Time
user.description: Set up prayer times for a location. Calculation defaults are taken from the core Islamic Prayer Times integration when it is configured (core integration: {core}).

data_description.name: Used as the device name, e.g. Prayer Times or Masjid.
data_description.calculation_method: Fajr / Isha angles used. Default matches the Home Assistant core integration.
data_description.midnight_mode: Defines the night used for Midnight and the last third.
data_description.use_home_location: Follows the home location in Settings → System → General. Turn off to enter coordinates manually.
data_description.use_home_elevation: Elevation lowers the horizon and moves Sunrise / Maghrib by a minute or two. Off = identical to the core integration.

location.title: Custom location
location.description: Coordinates of the mosque or city to calculate for.

offsets.title: Time adjustments
offsets.description: Fine-tune each time to match your local mosque timetable. These can also be changed later from the device page or a dashboard.

data_description.offset_fajr: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_sunrise: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_dhuhr: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_asr: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_maghrib: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_isha: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_imsak: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.offset_midnight: Minutes added to the calculated time (negative = earlier).
data_description.hijri_offset: Days to shift the Hijri date to match local moon sighting.
